description: A bottle of cough syrup drunk for entirely the wrong reason. Cheap, legal, and a long way down.

effects.comeon_message: Syrup-thick and cloying. You sit down to wait, which takes a surprisingly long time.

events.text: [trip]Your limbs get heavy and slightly further away than they were.[/trip]
[trip]You stand up and your body follows the plan a moment late, like a bad dub.[/trip]
[trip]The plateau. Everything is very far off and none of it's urgent.[/trip]
[trip]Sound arrives in slabs. You have been listening to the same second for a while.[/trip]
[trip]Something in the room has been waiting for you to notice it and is being patient.[/trip]
[trip]You start the long walk back up. It takes most of an evening.[/trip]

effects.onset_message: Your legs report in from a great distance. Everything you do arrives a half-second after you decide to do it.

overdose.message: Your heart goes somewhere fast and your breathing goes somewhere slow, and the two of them don't meet again.

effects.take_line: You drink the whole bottle of {name}, gagging on the sweetness.

withdrawal.message: Everything is too sharp and too close and moving at the wrong speed. You want the distance back.

stages.easing: The plateau lets you down onto flat ground, and the flat ground holds.
stages.onset: The distance goes. Everything is at the end of your arms again.
stages.peak: Nothing is happening at a remove any more. It's all happening at exactly the range it's happening at, which is here.
stages.rising: Sounds arrive on time, at full size, in the room you're in.
stages.tail: Near. Everything is near. You have got most of the way to used to it.

name: robo
